<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def right_all(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); r1=max(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
        if c0>=32 and n['color'] in ('R','b','W') and n['pixels']>=20:
            out.append((n['color'],n['pixels'],r0,r1,c0,c1))
    return sorted(out)
print("INIT right (R/b/bigW):",right_all(history[0].frame))
print("CURR right (R/b/bigW):",right_all(current_frame))
# Now test: click red hat again to see permutation behavior
res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':48}])
print("red hat again:", {k:res.get(k) for k in ('gameplay_changed','no_impact','board_changed','level_completed','done')})
def left_nodes(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); r1=max(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
        if c1<32 and n['color']!='c' and n['pixels']>=4:
            out.append((n['color'],n['pixels'],r0,r1,c0,c1))
    return sorted(out)
print("left after 2nd red click:",left_nodes(current_frame))

</function>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def right_all(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); r1=max(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
        if c0>=32 and n['color'] in ('R','b','W') and n['pixels']>=20:
            out.append((n['color'],n['pixels'],r0,r1,c0,c1))
    return sorted(out)
print("INIT right (R/b/bigW):",right_all(history[0].frame))
print("CURR right (R/b/bigW):",right_all(current_frame))
# Now test: click red hat again to see permutation behavior
res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':48}])
print("red hat again:", {k:res.get(k) for k in ('gameplay_changed','no_impact','board_changed','level_completed','done')})
def left_nodes(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); r1=max(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
        if c1<32 and n['color']!='c' and n['pixels']>=4:
            out.append((n['color'],n['pixels'],r0,r1,c0,c1))
    return sorted(out)
print("left after 2nd red click:",left_nodes(current_frame))
